mapper.insert: INSERT INTO train_gpu_device (gpu_uuid, host_signature, name, identity_state, schedulable, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{gpuUuid}, #{hostSignature}, #{name}, #{identityState}, #{schedulable}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE host_signature = VALUES(host_signature), name = VALUES(name), identity_state = VALUES(identity_state), schedulable = VALUES(schedulable), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT d.gpu_uuid, d.name, d.host_signature, d.identity_state, d.schedulable, s.sampled_at, s.total_memory_mib, s.used_memory_mib, s.utilization_percent, s.mig_mode, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM train_gpu_lease l WHERE l.gpu_uuid = d.gpu_uuid AND l.status = 'ACTIVE') AS has_active_lease, COALESCE(JSON_LENGTH(s.compute_processes), 0) AS external_process_count FROM train_gpu_device d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.gpu_uuid, t.sampled_at, t.total_memory_mib, t.used_memory_mib, t.utilization_percent, t.mig_mode, t.compute_processes FROM train_gpu_snapshot t JOIN ( SELECT gpu_uuid, MAX(sampled_at) AS m FROM train_gpu_snapshot GROUP BY gpu_uuid ) latest ON latest.gpu_uuid = t.gpu_uuid AND latest.m = t.sampled_at ) s ON s.gpu_uuid = d.gpu_uuid ORDER BY d.host_signature, d.gpu_uuid
